description: This Java class 'ConnectionMongoSnapshotAdapter' extends an abstract adapter to handle persistence (serialization/deserialization) of 'Connection' objects to and from MongoDB. It provides a constructor setting up logging and overrides a method to create 'Connection' instances from JSON objects, utilizing a migration utility.

classes.name: ConnectionMongoSnapshotAdapter
classes.description: A snapshot adapter class for Connection objects to persist to/from MongoDB, extending an abstract generic adapter and overriding creation from JSON.
